test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.**

“I finished my assignment two hours ago,” she said.

options.text: She said that she finished my assignment two hours ago.
She said that she had finished her assignment two hours before.
She said that I finished my assignment two hours before.
She said that she has finished her assignment two hours ago.

solution:
The indirect speech of the given sentence is__ **She said that she had finished her assignment two hours before.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 

 
 
She said 

 
 
 
I finished my assignment two hours ago.

 
 
 

__Reporting clause__ __Reported speech__

__
 
• When the reporting speech is in Simple Past tense then all the speech Changes to past perfect tense.

 
 
• Finished-----had finished
 
 
 
• Said of the reporting verb remains the same.
 
• Replace comma (,) and inverted commas (" ") with the conjunction 'that'.
 
• I(first person) of the Reported Speech changed according to the subject of the Reporting clause(She).
 
• **Ago **changed into **Before**.

 

​So, the final sentence is: She said that she had finished her assignment two hours before.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__What is Direct & Indirect Speech?__

 
• 
 Direct speech – reporting the message of the speaker in the exact words as spoken by him.

 
 
• Direct speech example: Maya said, "I am busy now".
 
 
 
• 
 Indirect speech: reporting the message of the speaker in our own words 

 
 
• Indirect speech example: Maya said that she was busy then.
